input.title: Stock settlement cycle to shorten to T+1 in 2028
input.summary: A headline reports that the stock settlement cycle will be shortened to T+1 in 2028, with sellers receiving proceeds the next day. No jurisdiction or regulator is named in the headline-only text.
evidence_quotes: Stock Settlement Cycle to Be Shortened to 'T+1' in 2028... Sellers to Receive Proceeds the Next Day
input.notes: headline_only; outlet is Korean (아시아경제), suggesting this may refer to a non-US market (e.g., South Korea) rather than the US. No jurisdiction or regulator named. Effect date of 2028-01-01 is a placeholder inferred from "2028" in the headline. Certainty set to 1 (announced/planned) as no confirmation of adoption.
